result.edit: Restrict the low-digit increment to Q[3:0] so the first cycle does not overwrite the whole register.

edits.replace:
always @(posedge CLR or posedge F_IN)
    begin
        if(CLR)Q <= 0;
        else begin
            if(ENA)begin
                if(F_IN)begin
                    if(Q[3:0]<9)Q[3:0] <= Q[3:0]+1;
edits.search:
always @(posedge CLR or posedge F_IN)
    begin
        if(CLR)Q <= 0;
        else begin
            if(ENA)begin
                if(F_IN)begin
                    if(Q[3:0]<9)Q <= Q+1;
